ostrzezenia.tekst: According to an OSU Extension answer on Ask Extension, a moist food submerged in lard and kept at room temperature is a risky food that could cause botulism poisoning.
Keep the refrigerator at 40 °F (4 °C) or lower.
For any low-acid food submerged in oil or fat, an OSU Extension answer recommends keeping it in the refrigerator for no more than 4 days.
Extension and USDA have no canning recommendations at all for tallow or lard.
